preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(row) <= 500 for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have a length between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell in {0, 1} for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: All cells in the grid must be either 0 (sea) or 1 (land).

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the number of land cells that cannot walk off the boundary.
